title: Game Play and Social Interactions
lead: The speaker initially made a mistake but later realized it, showing a process of learning and correction. This is evident from the quotes: 'You got it, don't worry. Oh.' and 'I think I really didn't.'

keyPoints: Check, check, one, two, check, one, two!
articleBodyHtml:
Initial Mistakes and Learning

The speaker initially made a mistake but later realized it, showing a process of learning and correction. This is evident from the quotes: 'You got it, don't worry. Oh.' and 'I think I really didn't.'

It took the speaker several attempts to master the game, indicating a learning curve. This is supported by the quote: 'it would take me, like, a few times to.'

To improve, the speaker borrowed phones from others, highlighting the collaborative and communal nature of the activity. This is reflected in the quote: 'borrowing, borrowing you guys' phones to play.'
